/-- The column permutation is the identity. The same physical row operation
is applied to all six columns, including both halves of the chosen strip. -/
theorem row_candidate_entry {H : OAI.MUB6.CMatrix} (hH : NormalizedCarrier H)
    (p : Perm) (i j : Fin 6) :
    candidate H p (Equiv.refl _) i j=H (p i) j*star (H (p 0) j) := by
  change (H (p 0) 0*star (H (p i) 0))*H (p i) j*star (H (p 0) j)=_
  simp only [hH.2.2,star_one,one_mul]

theorem candidate_monomial_equivalent {H : OAI.MUB6.CMatrix}
    (hH : OAI.MUB6.IsHadamard H) (p q : Perm) :
    OAI.MUB6.Equivalent H (candidate H p q) := by
  have hu := submatrix_hadamard hH p q
  refine ⟨p,q,normalizingRows (H.submatrix p q),normalizingCols (H.submatrix p q),
    normalizingRows_unit hu,normalizingCols_unit hu,?_⟩
  rfl

/-- The actual quartet-edge predicate is transported by the very same
candidate; no matrix-existence hypothesis is replaced by scalar data. -/
theorem rechart_preserves_quartet_occurrence {H : OAI.MUB6.CMatrix}
    (hH : AllCriticalCarrier H) (p : Perm)
    (ho : OccursAsQuartetEdge (normalizedNumerical H)) :
    OccursAsQuartetEdge (normalizedNumerical (candidate H p (Equiv.refl _))) :=
  candidate_occurs hH.1.1 ho p (Equiv.refl _)
